name: 原子：种草链路 - 参考图负反馈API契约与数据查询验证
description: 验证参考图负反馈复用 /api/afd/review/inspection/image/feedback 接口，提交后数据可通过 /api/afd/review/inspection/data 查询接口展示。包括：1)参考图负反馈请求参数正确性 2)负反馈后展示接口返回标记 3)素材右上角标记展示。

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { const t = row.textContent || ''; if ((t.includes('种草') || t.includes('套图')) && (t.includes('待开始') || t.includes('进行中') || t.includes('待审核'))) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '开始任务' || b.textContent?.trim() === '查看详情' || b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { if (row.textContent?.includes('待审核')) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { alreadyInDetail: true }; })()

(() => { if (!window.__capturedRequests) { window.__capturedRequests = []; const origFetch = window.fetch; window.fetch = async function(...args) { const url = typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : args[0]?.url || ''; const method = args[1]?.method || 'GET'; const body = args[1]?.body || null; window.__capturedRequests.push({ url, method, body: typeof body === 'string' ? body : JSON.stringify(body || {}), timestamp: Date.now() }); return origFetch.apply(this, args); }; } return { interceptorReady: true }; })()

steps._comment: ===== 点击参考图负反馈按钮并提交 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const fbBtn = document.querySelector('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--actionItem] img[alt="负反馈"]'); if (fbBtn) { fbBtn.closest('[class*=actionItem]').click(); return { clicked: true, area: 'refImage', mode: 'single' }; } const gridFb = document.querySelector('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn]'); if (gridFb) { gridFb.click(); return { clicked: true, area: 'refImage', mode: 'grid' }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 点击参考图负反馈按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal') || document.querySelector('.ant-popover'); if (!modal) return { submitted: false, reason: 'no modal' }; const option = modal.querySelector('.ant-checkbox-wrapper, .ant-radio-wrapper'); if (option) option.click(); const submitBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => /确\s*定|提\s*交/.test(b.textContent) && !b.disabled); if (submitBtn) { submitBtn.click(); return { submitted: true, selectedOption: option?.textContent?.trim() || '' }; } return { submitted: false, reason: 'no submit btn' }; })()

steps._comment: ===== 验证API调用：复用 image/feedback 接口 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const requests = window.__capturedRequests || []; const feedbackReqs = requests.filter(r => r.url.includes('image/feedback') || r.url.includes('inspection/image/feedback')); const dataReqs = requests.filter(r => r.url.includes('inspection/data')); return { totalCaptured: requests.length, feedbackRequestCount: feedbackReqs.length, feedbackRequests: feedbackReqs.map(r => ({ url: r.url, method: r.method, bodyPreview: (r.body || '').slice(0, 200) })), dataRequestCount: dataReqs.length, apiReused: feedbackReqs.length > 0 && feedbackReqs[0]?.url?.includes('/api/afd/review/inspection/image/feedback') }; })()

steps.description: 【PRD】断言参考图负反馈复用 /api/afd/review/inspection/image/feedback 接口

steps._comment: ===== 验证查询接口返回负反馈标记 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const requests = window.__capturedRequests || []; const dataReqs = requests.filter(r => r.url.includes('inspection/data')); if (dataReqs.length === 0) return { hasDataReq: false }; return { hasDataReq: true, dataUrl: dataReqs[0]?.url, dataMethod: dataReqs[0]?.method }; })()

steps._comment: ===== PRD：负反馈展示在素材右上角 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const badges = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=badge], [class*=tag], [class*=feedback], [class*=mark], [class*=icon]'); const feedbackBadges = []; for (const badge of badges) { const text = badge.textContent?.trim() || ''; const title = badge.getAttribute('title') || ''; const cls = badge.className || ''; if (/负反馈|feedback|背面|遮挡|不完整/i.test(text + title + cls)) { const rect = badge.getBoundingClientRect(); const parent = badge.closest('[class*=imageArea], [class*=imageContent]'); const parentRect = parent?.getBoundingClientRect(); const isTopRight = parentRect ? (rect.x > parentRect.x + parentRect.width * 0.6 && rect.y < parentRect.y + parentRect.height * 0.4) : false; feedbackBadges.push({ text: text.slice(0, 30), title, cls: cls.slice(0, 60), isTopRight, rect: { x: Math.round(rect.x), y: Math.round(rect.y) } }); } } return { feedbackBadgeCount: feedbackBadges.length, badges: feedbackBadges, hasTopRightBadge: feedbackBadges.some(b => b.isTopRight) }; })()
steps.description: 验证负反馈标记展示（PRD：素材右上角）

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在种草/套图审核任务
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 技术方案：负反馈接口复用 /api/afd/review/inspection/image/feedback；展示接口复用 /api/afd/review/inspection/data；PRD：负反馈展示在素材右上角
riskPoints: fetch拦截器可能无法捕获XHR请求（需同时拦截XMLHttpRequest）
负反馈标记展示可能延迟渲染
参考图负反馈的请求参数可能与结果图不同（需确认是否传imageType字段）
标记展示位置验证依赖精确坐标计算

prdMapping.接口复用: 参考图负反馈复用 image/feedback 接口
prdMapping.数据查询: inspection/data 接口返回含负反馈标记的数据
prdMapping.标记展示: 负反馈标记展示在素材右上角
